overlaps.rationale: Both refer to an exchange between people; the archive entry is specifically an informal conversation, while the candidate covers spoken or written exchanges more broadly.
The existing concept is casual conversation with matching Indonesian and Malaysian answers different from the candidate; the senses are closely related but not proven identical.
A meeting is a planned gathering, whereas conversation is the exchange itself and can occur without a meeting.
Discuss is an action of talking about a topic in detail; conversation is the spoken or written exchange, which may be informal or general.
